```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# =====================================================================================
# Replication results: Fahlenbrach, Rageth and Stulz (2021, RFS)
# Anthony Lamini - Advanced Financial Theorem
#
# Knit from the replication package folder (the folder with config.R and output/):
#   rmarkdown::render("replication_results.Rmd")      -> replication_results.pdf
# Requires: install.packages(c("rmarkdown", "knitr", "kableExtra", "data.table", "tinytex"))
#           tinytex::install_tinytex()   # once, if you have no LaTeX installed
# =====================================================================================
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, results = "asis")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(data.table); library(knitr); library(kableExtra) })
SAMPLE <- Sys.getenv("FFS_SAMPLE", "original")
SAMPLE_LABEL <- c(original = "Original-vintage sample", extended = "Extended sample")[[SAMPLE]]
TAB <- file.path("output", SAMPLE, "tables")
FIG <- file.path("output", SAMPLE, "figures")
if (!dir.exists(TAB)) stop("Knit this file from the replication package folder after running run_all.R (it needs output/<sample>/tables).")

rd <- function(name) {
  p <- file.path(TAB, paste0(name, ".csv"))
  if (!file.exists(p)) return(NULL)
  d <- as.data.frame(fread(p, colClasses = "character", header = TRUE, na.strings = NULL))
  d[is.na(d) | d == "NA"] <- ""
  d
}
# LaTeX-escape a text label; render "x" interactions as a times sign
tex <- function(s) {
  s <- gsub("\"+", "\"", s)
  s <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", s)
  s <- gsub("([&%$#_{}])", "\\\\\\1", s)
  s <- gsub(" x ", " $\\times$ ", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("<", "$<$", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("\"([^\"]*)\"", "``\\1''", s)
  s
}
# Typeset minus signs in numbers the way the paper does
mm <- function(s) gsub("(^|\\()-(?=[0-9.])", "\\1$-$", s, perl = TRUE)
# Paper labels: characteristics are dated 2019
relabel <- function(s) {
  s <- sub("^BM at EoY$", "BM at EoY 2019", s)
  s <- sub("^ln\\(MVE\\) at EoY$", "ln(MVE) at EoY 2019", s)
  s <- sub("^Momentum$", "Momentum 2019", s)
  s <- sub("^Adjusted R2$", "Adjusted $R^2$", s)
  s
}
fmt_num <- function(v, digits = 3) {          # whole-number columns without decimals, others with
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", v)))
  ok <- is.finite(x)
  whole <- any(ok) && all(abs(x[ok] - round(x[ok])) < 1e-9)
  out <- ifelse(!ok, ifelse(is.na(x), v, ""),
                if (whole) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",") else formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ","))
  mm(out)
}
hdr <- function(s, width = 16) {               # wrap a column header over several lines
  vapply(s, function(z) paste(strwrap(tex(z), width = width), collapse = "\n"), "")
}
# Wrap a finished LaTeX table with the paper-style heading, optionally on a landscape page
emit <- function(number, title, desc, body, land = FALSE) {
  cat("\n```{=latex}\n\\clearpage\n")
  if (land) cat("\\begin{landscape}\n")
  cat(sprintf("\\tabhead{%s}{%s}{%s}\n", number, title, desc))
  cat(body, "\n")
  if (land) cat("\\end{landscape}\n")
  cat("```\n\n")
}
missing_tab <- function(number, title) {
  cat("\n```{=latex}\n\\clearpage\n")
  cat(sprintf("\\tabhead{%s}{%s}{Not estimated in this replication: the table requires the Koren and Peto (2020) industry exposure measures, which were not available.}\n", number, title))
  cat("```\n\n")
}

# Regression table in the paper's layout: numbered columns, coefficient rows with
# t-statistics in parentheses beneath, a rule above the summary rows.
regtab <- function(d, colnames = NULL, size = 8, width = 14) {
  lab <- d[[1]]; vals <- d[-1]
  summ <- which(lab %in% c("Controls", "Industry fixed effects", "Observations", "Adjusted R2") |
                grepl("^One-sided", lab))
  lab <- relabel(ifelse(lab %in% c("Adjusted R2"), lab, tex(lab)))
  vals[] <- lapply(vals, mm)
  k <- ncol(vals)
  out <- data.frame(lab, vals, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cn <- if (is.null(colnames)) names(d)[-1] else colnames
  names(out) <- c("", linebreak(hdr(cn, width), align = "c"))
  kt <- kable(out, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("c", k)),
              linesep = "") |>
    kable_styling(font_size = size, latex_options = "hold_position") |>
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, setNames(rep(1, k), sprintf("(%d)", seq_len(k)))), line = FALSE)
  if (length(summ)) kt <- row_spec(kt, min(summ) - 1, hline_after = TRUE)
  kt
}
fig <- function(file) file.exists(file.path(FIG, file))
```

```{r appendix-a}
d <- rd("appendix_a")
if (!is.null(d)) {
  x <- as.numeric(d$Firms); d$Firms <- mm(formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ","))
  d$Step <- tex(d$Step)
  n <- nrow(d)
  body <- kable(d, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = c("l", "r"), linesep = "", col.names = NULL) |>
    kable_styling(font_size = 10, latex_options = "hold_position") |>
    row_spec(max(which(x[-n] > 0)), hline_after = TRUE) |> row_spec(n - 1, hline_after = TRUE)
  emit("Appendix A", "Sample selection procedure",
       sprintf("%s. Compustat North America firms with fiscal year 2019 data, after each screen.", SAMPLE_LABEL), body)
}
```

```{r table-c1}
d <- rd("table_c1")
if (!is.null(d)) {
  d$Variable <- tex(d$Variable)
  d[-1] <- lapply(d[-1], fmt_num)
  names(d)[1] <- ""
  body <- kable(d, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(d) - 1)), linesep = "") |>
    kable_styling(font_size = 9, latex_options = "hold_position")
  emit("Table C1", "Summary statistics",
       "Summary statistics for the raw data and the derived measures of COVID-19 exposure of firms and industries. TQ (BQ) indicates an indicator for the top (bottom) quartile.", body)
}
```

```{r table1}
d <- rd("table1")
if (!is.null(d)) {
  lab <- d$Variable
  d$Variable <- relabel(tex(lab))
  d[-1] <- lapply(d[-1], fmt_num)
  names(d)[1] <- ""
  ncov <- sum(grepl("^Cum. daily exc|^Daily exc|^ROA", lab))
  ngfc <- sum(grepl("^GFC:", lab))
  d[[1]] <- sub("^GFC: ", "", d[[1]])
  body <- kable(d, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(d) - 1)), linesep = "") |>
    kable_styling(font_size = 7, latex_options = "hold_position") |>
    pack_rows("Dependent variables: COVID-19-related", 1, ncov, escape = FALSE) |>
    pack_rows("Dependent variables: GFC-related", ncov + 1, ncov + ngfc, escape = FALSE) |>
    pack_rows("Independent and other variables", ncov + ngfc + 1, nrow(d), escape = FALSE)
  emit("Table 1", "Summary statistics",
       "Summary statistics for the dependent and independent variables. The sample consists of all nonfinancial and nonutility U.S. firms with fiscal year 2019 data in Compustat that pass the screens in Appendix A. GFC, global financial crisis.",
       body, land = TRUE)
}
```

```{r table3}
d <- rd("table3")
if (!is.null(d)) {
  emit("Table 3", "Stock returns, financial flexibility measures, and stock and firm characteristics",
       "Cross-sectional regressions of stock returns in excess of the risk-free rate on firm characteristics. Collapse period: cumulative return from February 3 to March 23, 2020. Stimulus day: return on March 24, 2020. Columns 7 and 8 use the global financial crisis, with cumulative returns from September 15, 2008, to December 31, 2008, and to March 9, 2009, and firm characteristics measured in fiscal year 2006. All regressions include Fama-French 49 industry fixed effects. $t$-statistics are in parentheses. *$p<.1$; **$p<.05$; ***$p<.01$.",
       regtab(d, c("Collapse period", "Stimulus day", "Collapse period", "Stimulus day", "Collapse period",
                   "Stimulus day", "Global financial crisis ending Dec 31, 2008", "Global financial crisis ending March 9, 2009"),
              size = 8, width = 13))
}
```

```{r table4}
d <- rd("table4")
if (is.null(d)) missing_tab("Table 4", "Bottom-20 NAICS three-digit industries cumulative returns and industry characteristics: GFC versus COVID-19 crisis") else {
  d[] <- lapply(d, function(v) fmt_num(tex(v)))
  names(d) <- c("NAICS", "Affected share", "Lt debt / assets", "PPE / assets", "CR",
                "NAICS ", "Affected share ", "Lt debt / assets ", "PPE / assets ", "CR ")
  body <- kable(d, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = "c", linesep = "") |>
    kable_styling(font_size = 8, latex_options = "hold_position") |>
    add_header_above(c("Global financial crisis" = 5, "COVID-19 crisis" = 5)) |>
    row_spec(nrow(d) - 2, hline_after = TRUE)
  emit("Table 4", "Bottom-20 NAICS three-digit industries cumulative returns and industry characteristics: GFC versus COVID-19 crisis",
       "The 20 NAICS three-digit industries with the lowest equal-weighted cumulative excess return (CR) from September 15, 2008, to March 9, 2009 (left) and from February 3 to March 23, 2020 (right). * marks industries in the bottom 20 in both crises.", body)
}
```

```{r table7}
d <- rd("table7")
if (!is.null(d)) {
  grp <- d$Group
  t7 <- data.frame(Variable = tex(d$Variable), lapply(d[3:8], fmt_num), check.names = FALSE)
  names(t7) <- c("", "N", "Median", "Mean", "N ", "Median ", "Mean ")
  kt <- kable(t7, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("r", 6)), linesep = "") |>
    kable_styling(font_size = 9, latex_options = "hold_position") |>
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "2019 payouts / 2019 assets" = 3, "(2017+2018+2019 payouts) / 2019 assets" = 3))
  for (g in unique(grp)) { i <- which(grp == g); kt <- pack_rows(kt, g, min(i), max(i)) }
  emit("Table 7", "Payout ratios by quartile and financial flexibility measures",
       "Financial flexibility measures and payout ratios for the entire sample and by payout-ratio quartile. (Cash + payout) / (assets + payout) is the cash-to-assets ratio had the firm retained its payouts; (Lt debt $-$ payout) / assets is the long-term debt ratio had the firm used its payouts to repay long-term debt. The left panel uses 2019 payouts; the right panel uses cumulative 2017--2019 payouts over 2019 assets.",
       kt)
}
```
